newsitem.title: USA: Med Asset Management restated earnings. [CORRECTED 19:33 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Med Asset Management restated earnings. [CORRECTED 19:33 GMT]

text.p: Medical Asset Management Inc said in November 1996 it had restated its interim results for September 30, 1996 and for prior periods to reflect changes in accounting policies.
The company said it had experienced delays in closing its financial records for 1996 and the first quarter 1997, and results could be available by June 30.
Restatements included a reclassification of revenues to reflect the contractual allocation of revenues to medical owners of clinics and medical practices managed by the company, it said.
Changes also included a correction of accounting for contingent stock which was to be issued in future years under management agreements, the company said.

Until 1996 results are finalized, Medical Asset Management said it was unsure if additional restatements would be needed (corrects to make clear that it is the 1996 audit that is under way and not the restatement).
